blockingIssues.description: The ScenePainter-focused coverage still only checks initial deferred scroll-indicator flush order. There is still no ScenePainter-visible proof for replayed deferred overlays or nested deferred subtree parent-before-child ordering, even though validation-contract.md requires focused ScenePainterTests evidence for VAL-PARITY-004 and VAL-PARITY-005. Neither the prior failed commit e24713a nor the reviewed fix commit d6d20c7 touches this file.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a mandatory final handoff-versus-diff verification step before EndFeatureRun so the claimed commit, changed files, and added tests are checked against `git show --stat` (or equivalent) and any still-uncommitted implementation is caught before handoff.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: This issue recurred across parity-harness fixes: round 2 found a handoff that claimed new RetainedViewRuntimeTests coverage while `git show --stat e24713a` only changed `Sources/SwiftWindowsUI/Runtime.swift`, and round 3 found the handoff for `fix-scene-focused-deferred-proof-and-subtree-rerun` claimed commit `d6d20c7` added two `.subtree` rerun tests even though `git show --stat d6d20c7` only changed the VAL-PARITY-003 scroll-parity test while the subtree-test additions remained uncommitted in `Tests/SwiftWindowsCoreLogicTests/RetainedViewRuntimeTests.swift`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify that scrutiny-fix or evidence-hardening features may satisfy the 'tests first' expectation by tightening an existing focused test in place, rather than always adding a brand-new failing test case, as long as the strengthened test directly closes the cited proof gap.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `fix-direct-scroll-delta-and-indicator-parity` review passed after the worker rewrote the existing VAL-PARITY-003 test to directly compare frame-vs-scene scroll delta and indicator geometry, but the current skill wording only says to 'Add failing focused tests before implementation' and does not explain that strengthening an existing focused test is acceptable for this kind of scrutiny fix.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When a contract assertion explicitly names both runtime and ScenePainter-focused suites, state that runtime-owned prepaint architecture notes do not relax the requirement to land visible proof in both harnesses; workers should add the ScenePainterTests evidence the contract asks for instead of assuming existing runtime tests are sufficient.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The round-3 re-review for `fix-scene-focused-deferred-proof-and-subtree-rerun` found the worker added `.subtree` backend-switch rerun tests in `RetainedViewRuntimeTests.swift` but still left `ScenePainterTests.swift` unchanged, even though validation-contract.md requires focused ScenePainter-visible evidence for VAL-PARITY-004 and VAL-PARITY-005. The review explicitly called out the guidance mismatch between runtime-owned prepaint architecture notes and the contract's dual-suite requirement.
